snippet.title: Official Preview Trailer - DragonSword : Awakening
snippet.description:
The journey to become the hero who will save the world, 「DragonSword」 is about to begin. 
Recruit unique companions in an anime-style open world brought to life with Unreal Engine 5, and experience flashy status effect tag-action combat!

"DragonSword : Awakening" is set to officially launch on Steam this coming July.
Stay up to date with the latest news through our various channels.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4570720/
Discord: https://discord.gg/CzZ5ddkMVg
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@DragonSwordAwakening
